examples.note: Fixed line — 5 digits; the 20xxx and 22–29xxx ranges are Telecom Vanuatu
Mobile — 7x ranges; mobile numbers are one digit longer than fixed

notes: Vanuatu NSNs vary from 5 to 7 digits by service, so length is not a reliable validator.
National destination codes are allocated per operator (Telecom Vanuatu, Digicel Vanuatu).
sources: TRBR — Telecommunications, Radiocommunications and Broadcasting Regulator: https://www.trbr.vu/
